connector.name: Kakunin by nqzai
connector.registryDescription: X.509 identity, risk scoring, and audit logging for AI agents. MiCA + EU AI Act compliant.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nqzai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KAKUNIN_API_KEY

env.name: KAKUNIN_AGENT_ID
env.description: ID of the agent this MCP server acts on behalf of (agt_...).
